answer: Witness-chained key derivation: each agent identity's signing key must derive from a sequential proof-of-work chain, where every new key's seed includes the hash of the prior key's registration block. A clone can only reuse a chain by replaying that proof, so a duplicate identity costs the full compute of its ancestry. Any fork—the pearl of two identical chains diverging—gets flagged when gossiped registration records fail the hash check. Honest nodes gossip a crystal of each chain's head, and a comet of mismatched heads exposes the duplication.
